messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate on serving-cluster-3 — RPC timeouts, RDMA link resets, and container restarts detected. Alert group: serving.runtime.network. root cause unknown.
priya: taking pager. oncall -> priya. I'll start triage.
ryan: saw spikes in qdelays around that time, likely RDMA QP resets. grabbing logs from the runtime nodes.
emi: i'm patching in to help with infra-level checks (fabric + switches). any impacted customer list?
sara: support reports 4 customers seeing increased 5xxs and latency >10s since ~11:04 UTC. two on dedicated clusters.
priya: severity = P1. impact: degraded/failed responses for some hosts. mitigation goal: restore RPCs and stop container churn.
ryan: tail of runtime log on serve-03: 
```
2026-07-15T11:04:12Z serve-03 kernel: mlx5_core 0000:03:00.0: XRQ error: link down, attempting reset
2026-07-15T11:04:14Z runtime[pid=4021]: cuda error: illegal memory access during generation
2026-07-15T11:04:15Z runtime[pid=4021]: container OOM killer invoked for process 4021
```
emi: can everybody run quick fabric checks on affected hosts? 
- on host: `ibstat` 
- check port counters: `cat /sys/class/infiniband/mlx5_0/ports/1/counters/if_rcv_discards`
- `ethtool -S` for mlx5 interface
ryan: running `ibv_devinfo` + `ibstat` now. seeing PortState: Active but link flaps in counters. if_rcv_discards jumping.
priya: good. immediate mitigations: 
1) route new requests away from cluster-3 to fallback pool (us-west-fallback) via routing policy A.
2) scale down server batch size to reduce queuing.
3) cordon nodes with most resets from scheduler to avoid restarts -> emi to coordinate.
emi: cordoning serve-02 and serve-03 now. `kubectl cordon serve-02` `kubectl cordon serve-03` -> draining deferred because canary traffic should stay until fallback warms.
ryan: starting a runtime-level fallback: switch smart-routing policy to prefer tcp-over-ethernet for models that have a tcp variant. issuing rollout in console.
sara: informing affected customers + status page: drafting message — will include ETA ~15-30m and mitigation steps.
luca: any ETA on fabric fix? switches show flaps on leaf-7 to spine-2. looks like intermittent SFP errors, suspect port-level hardware. contacting infra ops vendor.
emi: vendor responded, planning to replace optics in 10-15m. meanwhile we need to keep requests stable.
priya: action list so far: 
- priya: own incident & update channel every 5m.
- ryan: complete smart-routing rollback to tcp fallback, confirm latency for fallback paths.
- emi: coordinate cordon + vendor optics swap, collect interface counters pre/post.
- sara: customer comms + ticket grouping.
- luca: run impact blast radius and list of clusters/customers affected.
ryan: quick mitigation commands i ran: 
```
# reduce batch and concurrency on model route
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $API" \
  https://console.internal/api/routes/serve-embedding/config \
  -d '{"max_batch_size":8,"concurrency":1}'
# switch routing policy
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/routing/override -d '{"policy":"tcp-fallback","until":"now+30m"}'
```
priya: ry, after switch, what do success metrics look like?
ryan: within 2m of policy flip, error rate dropped from 12% -> 1.8% for the fallback pool. p50 latency increased ~60ms but stable. no new OOMs observed on fallback hosts.
emi: vendor swapped SFP on leaf-7 at 11:18 UTC, saw immediate drop in rx discard counters. attaching sample counters: `if_rcv_discards` went 1200 -> 2.
priya: great. are there any pending container crashes to clean up?
ryan: restarting a handful of containers on serve-03 after cordon + drain. cores indicate memory growth due to retry storms — we saw repeated requeues when RDMA QPs reset. added a guard in runtime to cap retry queue to prevent OOM. pushing hotfix now.
sara: status page updated: "Partial service degradation affecting some clusters. Mitigation in progress. Next update in 15 minutes."
luca: created customer group ticket INC-2248, listing 4 customers and affected endpoints + timestamps.
priya: handoff note for next oncall: 
- root cause: intermittent IB port flaps between leaf-7 and spine-2 causing RDMA QP resets -> runtime retries -> memory growth -> container restarts. 
- mitigations applied: traffic routed to tcp-fallback, nodes cordoned, optics swapped, runtime retry cap hotfix deployed.
- still open: verify long-term fabric stability, consider replacing problematic NIC or move affected hosts to different leaf.
priya: emi, ry, please confirm once counters stable for 30m, then we'll start uncordoning slowly.
emi: counters stable for 12m now. continuing monitoring.
ryan: hotfix pushed, runtime has retry cap, no more OOMs in last 10m.
priya: closing pager in 30m if metrics hold. final note: good triage + quick routing fallback prevented wider customer impact. :white_check_mark:
